defects.finding: R1 changed official masculine genitive plural komponentov to komponent to agree with a locally inconsistent feminine singular. Official dictionary row 20148 gives masculine komponent; the correct repair is instead primarna komponenta to primarny komponent at Paper 45 line 489.

R1 hashed the transaction-core path and then reopened it through the import loader, leaving a check-to-load race. The successor must compile and execute the already authenticated bytes in memory and reauthenticate the disk pin immediately before apply.

disposition: Preserve this receipt as adverse history. R1 is not authorized for application; build and independently review an exact R2 successor.
